intent: A column of links, one a row with a chevron at the end, like an account's quick links.
useWhen: Quick links in a record's side rail
A few related pages to jump to from a settings or detail page
doNotUseWhen: Actions that change data — use Button or DropdownMenu
Page navigation across the app — use AppNav, SideNav, or Tabs
People, files, or other records one per row — use ListView
A single link in text — use an anchor in body copy

href.note: Where the row goes. Without it the row is a button that runs onClick.

icon.note: lucide-react export name from the Foundations catalog, before the label.

description.note: A short line under the label.

external.note: Opens in a new tab; the chevron becomes the new-tab mark.

items.note: The links in order. Keep it short: two to eight.

label.note: Names the list for screen readers, like Quick links.

requirements: A list named by label, so the number of links is read
Each row is one link, or a button when it has no href, reachable with Tab, with a visible focus ring
The chevron and icon are hidden from screen readers; external rows say opens in a new tab

doNot: Do not use it for actions that change data — use Button or DropdownMenu
Do not use it for page navigation across the app — use AppNav or Tabs
Do not put it in a Card or draw a box round it yourself — put it in a Section
Do not build a list of Links or a one-column Table for quick links — use LinkList
Do not use ListView for quick links
Do not pass custom SVG as icon — use lucide-react export names
Do not use raw hex or primitive --color-* ramps
snippet:
<Section title="Quick links">
  <LinkList label="Quick links" items={[{ id: "tax", label: "Tax Related List", href: "/tax" }, { id: "portal", label: "Customer Portal", href: "/portal" }]} />
</Section>
